observations: The copied version-9 minute-78 checkpoint restored in the new built browser with the same four object IDs and both registered GLBs. At minute 79 Bo accepted Ada's offered session social-29-7; the relationship stayed 50.

A typed PC spawn placed a built-in wall over Ada's observed position (0, -3.75). The connected browser returned an applied Matrix receipt and showed five objects. At minute 80, Ada logged conversation route retry 1/3 while the same social session and both participant bindings remained active. Social need was 42.1 each and relationship 50, with no converse completion.

The browser saved named PC whole-world checkpoint social-route-retry-m80 with Citizens version 12, routeRetries 1, the wall and five exact scene objects. Reloading /web/ retained minute 80, the active session and retry 1/3 after both GLBs rendered.

A typed set_transform command moved that wall to (4, 4) and received an applied browser receipt. Twelve paused Step actions continued the same social-29-7 session to minute 92. The exact Matrix converse receipt citizens-29-social-7-100 ended it once, raised each social need to 75.9 and relationship 50 to 55. The named checkpoint social-route-recovered-m92 contains one completed relationship proof.

Restoring social-route-retry-m80 with the wall still over Ada produced retry 2/3 at minute 81, retry 3/3 at minute 82, then one interrupted event at minute 83. Both residents were released, social need had decayed to 41.8 each, and relationship remained 50 with no completed receipt. The named checkpoint social-route-blocked-m83 preserves that terminal state.

Restoring the same minute-80 checkpoint, moving the wall to (4, 4) again, and taking the same twelve browser Step actions reproduced the exact minute-92 whole-world payload SHA-256. A final browser reload retained the five objects, completed session, receipt, social needs and relationship. Browser console errors were zero.

After the final JS build and PC validator change, the isolated PC service restarted. The rebuilt browser restored the v12 minute-80 retry checkpoint, showed the same active session and route retries 1/3, then restored the minute-92 completion with five objects and zero browser console errors.
limits: This browser run exercised a static floor-aligned authored wall over the initiator, not a moving resident or animated obstacle. Focused tests cover non-route and uncertain movement receipts, migration and malformed saved states.
The retry budget is three failed travel ticks within the existing 72-tick accepted-session expiry. An invitation, retry or movement alone grants no social need or relationship benefit.
General path recovery for moving targets, full issue #15 and #19 acceptance, larger social planning or dialogue, and independent Quest wearer checks remain open.
